description.value:
Trigger A starship moves within 1 zone of the hazard or uses any scanners station action targeting the hazard's zone

Effect The trap launches a targeted ad enticing viewers to spend credits on a product or service. All creatures that can see, hear, or sense the ad (including through starship sensors) must attempt a @Check[will|dc:17] save. The trap rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Dazzled].

Failure The creature is dazzled and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Fascinated] until the hazard is disabled.

Critical Failure The creature is dazzled and fascinated, and it can't take any actions except to access the nearest computer or comm unit and make purchases as directed by the ad; these effects last until the hazard is disabled.

details.description: A hijacked Drift beacon broadcasts obnoxious ads or some other repetitive message.
details.disable: @Check[computers|dc:20] (trained) to repair the Drift beacon's code, @Check[crafting|dc:22] (trained) to disassemble the trap, or @Check[religion|dc:23] (trained) to consecrate it for Triune
details.reset: The trap deactivates and resets after 1 minute.
details.routine: (1 action) The hazard plays a new ad, forcing all creatures that can sense it to attempt a new save against Spam Storm.
